name: After § 12
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Georgia’s worsening democratic crisis following the recent parliamentary elections and alleged electoral fraud
part_text: 12a. Acknowledges that, as discussed during the meeting of Parliament’s Committee on Foreign Affairs on 18 November 2024, the irregularities reported in Georgia’s parliamentary elections were not deemed sufficient enough by international observers to invalidate the election results; urges the EU to maintain a balanced approach to analysing the electoral situation and respect Georgia’s internal democratic processes;
